issues: Legend shows 'unknown' twice (once for null category, once for 'unknown' string) — dedupe categories in /api/analytics/categories by coalescing null → 'unknown'

action_items: url_features.py: implement remaining ~15 features to reach the advertised 55+ feature set (or update PRD/UI labels to reflect the true 40). Update ScanResult.jsx 'URL FEATURE ANALYSIS · 22 SIGNALS' label to dynamically show url_analysis.feature_count.

AdminPage.jsx: wrap the initial Promise.all in try/catch and show a spinner/skeleton so a slow first load does not briefly render 'USERS · 0 / All caught up' (transient empty state during ~2-3s parallel fetch).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:39-41 raises KeyError at import time if MONGO_URL/DB_NAME missing (good fast-fail per env rules).
server.py:412-415 cookie is samesite='none'+secure=true — REQUIRED for cross-site preview URL. Verified with credentials: include fetch.
auth.py:105-109 correctly re-hashes admin password if env password changed (idempotent seed).

server.py /api/crawler/run: Depends(get_current_user) evaluated before the 409 check — verified 401 returned for unauthenticated requests via curl (not admin required though — any logged-in user can trigger).
server.py /api/threats/{id}/vote: still no per-user vote idempotency (carried over from V1 review). A single user can spam votes.
server.py analytics_timeseries uses lexicographic ISO-string comparison for cutoff — works but stores datetimes as strings; consider native BSON Date for performance at scale.
AuthContext.jsx: axios.defaults.withCredentials=true is module-level; the useEffect interceptor for Bearer header registers on mount — both paths verified working (cookie + header).
AdminPage.jsx load() has no try/catch; a single failing endpoint would silently break all three lists.
ScanResult component text 'URL FEATURE ANALYSIS · 22 SIGNALS' is hardcoded — should use {url_analysis.feature_count}.

rca of the issue: Only known deviation: url_features.extract_features returns 40 features but V2 spec claims 55+ and ScanResult.jsx label says '22 SIGNALS'. Root cause: url_features.py was expanded past V1 (22 features) but not to the full 55+ advertised in the review_request. UI label was never re-templated. Mitigation: (a) add the missing ~15 features in url_features.py OR (b) update review_request/PRD + ScanResult label to accurately reflect 40 features.
